always.title: Here for good
always.lead: Many leave without a framework or a roadmap. We're not a program with a start and an end. We're a place that stays.
body: Come for the first time now, or come back after a break, also after a round of reserve duty. There are three meetings a month, so there is always a Friday coming up.

direction.title: Community centers across Israel
body: Together with local municipalities, we're building a nationwide network of centers for discharged combat veterans.
Each center: a veterans’ club, classes and workshops, and life skills and leadership training.
Today, Friday mornings take place at Holmes Place in Modi'in. That's where it starts.
